parsed.note: WINDOW_PATTERN=SSSL only changes a training hyperparameter while the fixed eval block and the exclusion of eval shard 7 from TRAIN_SHARDS remain untouched, so val_bpb still measures real model quality (the large 1.013→0.877 jump is surprising but not a metric compromise).
